To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the SOEC is a set of practices that are being implemented by social players with different perspectives; (ii) the practices of selfmanagement, solidarity and full worker power are the most common; (iii) the public policy is a key element in the viability of solidarity experiences; (iv) the public policy in the area of social economy is progressing significantly and is strengthening the social players.

the SOEC is a form of organization that allows workers who are excluded from the labour force to generate income and, at the same time, to build solidarity relationships with the society in which they live.

the Solidarity Economics (SE) practices are an alternative for the construction of alternatives to the development of the territories, and the government has a major role in the development of these practices.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: What are the main characteristics of Social Economics in Brazil?
the following questions: What are the main characteristics of the SOEC in the context of Brazil?
the following questions: What are the characteristics of SOEC practices in Brazil?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the development of social and economic practices in the Solidarity Economy is a promising alternative for the construction of a more just and democratic society.

the SOEC are not only an interesting alternative to address the issue of unemployment, but they are also a means to generate income, which in turn, is an important element in the construction of a more equitable society.
there are still many gaps in the research on the subject, which is a challenge to the researchers.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

of a study of the practices of Social Economy (SE) and Solidarity Economics (SEE) in Brazil, in the context of the construction of alternatives to economic development, and with a focus on the role of public policy in this process.
of an analysis of the theoretical and practical approaches of Social Economics in Brazil, with a view toward the construction of alternatives in the territorial development of the country.
, in the context of the current economic and social crisis, SOEC are an alternative to the generation of employment and income.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there is a growing interest in SOEC in Brazil and that it is a practice which is being consolidated and gaining importance.

the development of public policies in this area is still in its initial stage and there is a need to deepen the debate in order to make these policies more effective and sustainable, as well as to ensure the autonomy and the sustainability of these initiatives.

the development of public policies aimed at the Solidarity Economy in Brazil is a major challenge, since it is necessary to overcome the difficulties of the current economic system and the political and social system.
